text: Pregnant guitar technician Beth visits her estranged sister Ellie, a single mother of three in a Los Angeles apartment block. An earthquake opens [a hidden chamber beneath the parking lot|trigger|unsealing what was shut away], and Ellie's son Danny brings home a strange book and [records from 1923 of a priest reciting an incantation|origin|deliberately called up]. With the power out, the stairs collapsed and [no way out of the building|rules|trapped with no way out], Ellie is [possessed and turns on her own children|archetypes|The Devouring Mother].
